decisions.reason: The organic salami platter is a multi-model line central to the firm's announced organic expansion and has stayed on the website for two years, so management remains committed despite its modest presentation.

Visibility has slipped from its own page to a mere mention, but the multi-model premium snack line represents sunk investment in new formats, so management will likely attribute weaker results to temporary market conditions and persist.
Launched recently with its own page and fitting the organic direction, the product is too new to judge, and the visible commitment favors continuing it.
This multi-model organic chicken line has a dedicated page and embodies the announced move into organic and ingredient-conscious offerings, making retention highly likely.
The new organic salami variant is prominently presented and close to the core offer, so early results would be read as start-up effects rather than a reason to withdraw.
